content: The superior man blames himself. The inferior man blames others.
author: Confucius
explanation: The hallmark of spiritual and psychological maturity is radical personal accountability. When misfortune or failure strikes, the noble soul seeks the locus of change within their own conduct.
practicalInsight: Take 100% ownership of a current friction point in your life without passing blame to circumstances or colleagues.
reflectionPrompt: Where have you been making excuses or blaming external factors instead of examining your own agency?
